cm.rain.dimension_matrix.name: Dimension Matrix
poc.matrix.port.input_hint: Facing the controller front: place in the LEFT wall; connect energy outside.
poc.matrix.port.output_hint: Facing the controller front: place in the RIGHT wall; energy exits outside.
poc.matrix.port.rate_hint: Ports on one matrix share 1,000,000 FE/t per transfer direction.
poc.matrix.port.unbound: Port inactive: check wall side, complete structure and controller chunk.
poc.matrix.projector.hint: Install one at each of the four designated base positions; powered modules project toward the core.
poc.matrix.projector.danger: Interior exposure deals 8 health/s, including Creative. Coolant loss heats the matrix; maximum heat detonates an 11x11x11 chunk-section volume.
poc.matrix.coolant.hint: Optional in the back 9x9 wall. Water coolant enters outside; shared 64,000 mB. Running: 100 mB/s.
poc.matrix.jei.coolant: Optional coolant input in the back wall. Default coolant: water.
death.attack.dimension_shear: %1$s was torn apart by a dimensional projection
subtitles.poc_dimension_matrix.power_on: Dimension Matrix: projection array powers on
poc.matrix.jei.title: Modpack Multiblock Construction
poc.matrix.jei.controller: Controller position. This is a building guide, not a crafting recipe.
poc.matrix.jei.replaceable: Some positions accept alternatives. Hover individual layer cells for exact rules.
poc.matrix.jei.left_port: Optional: input ports in the LEFT 9x9 wall, facing the controller front.
poc.matrix.jei.right_port: Optional: output ports in the RIGHT 9x9 wall, facing the controller front.
poc.matrix.jei.optional: Replace wall blocks or air. Excludes the base, top frame and front/rear pillars.
poc.matrix.jei.help: Scroll: zoom; left drag: rotate/pan layer; right drag: pan; -/+: layers; center: reset.
poc.matrix.jei.combined: Some processing recipes require %s structures simultaneously. Check this machine's related plans.
poc.matrix.jei.position: Relative to controller: X %s, Y %s, Z %s
poc.matrix.jei.matrix_hint: Default build shown. Optional ports fit in the left/right walls.
poc.matrix.jei.space_hint: Layer coordinates are relative to the controller. Spaces are unrestricted; air must stay empty.
